review_role: Separate constructor-output reviewer at the preblind repair stage; not the post-development final audit.
readiness_basis: The public pair removes direct site disclosure while retaining the indexed scope, resolves the demonstrated NA ambiguity, and preserves the seven-field truth. Actual supplied execution and validation support the unchanged reference assets. The hardest supplied legacy mechanism has been compared using primary-source evidence. The independent ruling supports the required minimum discovery dependency.

scope_review.public_scope: ISSN 0940-1334; indexed publication year 2026; volume 276; issue 2; indexed membership observed 12 September 2026.
scope_review.change: Removed Europe PMC's attribution from both scope paragraphs. No website, URL or start_url is introduced into either public object.
scope_review.preserved_universe: The original controller-preserved indexed issue remains the construction universe. No annual-year, online-date, open-access-only, PMCID-only, publisher-only, or unrestricted-search replacement was made.
scope_review.primary_corroboration: The publisher identifies volume 276 issue 2 as March 2026, lists 47 articles, and places the quantitative and author-only correction notices in that issue. Their online dates are in 2025. This corroborates the natural issue identity and the task-relevant notice scope accepted in the supplied indexed screening. [Publisher issue](https://link.springer.com/journal/406/volumes-and-issues/276-2)
scope_review.equivalence_limit: Publisher issue metadata supports the same natural journal issue and the same two task-relevant notices here. It is not proof that every publisher identity equals every saved indexed identity: the full 47-row indexed inventory was not supplied inline, and equal counts alone cannot establish that. Accordingly r02 retains indexed membership rather than asserting universal index/publisher equivalence or replacing the saved universe.
scope_review.date_handling: The construction observation remains 12 September 2026. The nested current_date value of 9 September is not used to alter that explicit task boundary. Fresh web observations corroborate content and do not replace the preserved snapshot.

content_ambiguity_repaired.old_text: Use NA if a notice does not correct a requested count.
content_ambiguity_repaired.problem: Read literally across all four numeric fields, this can suppress directly requested, uncorrected population totals and disagree with the verified reference.
content_ambiguity_repaired.replacement: For help_n and nondepressed_n, use NA if no qualifying notice corrects that count. Report initial_n and analyzed_n even if those totals were not corrected.
content_ambiguity_repaired.effect: Makes the existing distinction between correction outcomes and population context explicit. No field, source value, oracle row, numerical logic, alias, sorting rule or scorer behavior is changed.

dependency_review.basis: Supplied INDEPENDENT MECHANISM RULING: observed issue membership produces the PMCIDs that determine later evidence-bearing full-text retrieval. Population evidence is absent from metadata and appears in those responses.
dependency_review.not_required: A correction-first request followed by a newly triggered original-paper request is not required and was bypassed by the same-issue batch.
dependency_review.limitation: The ruling establishes neither universal shortcut resistance nor difficulty. No stronger dependency claim is made.

legacy_comparison.selection_status: Reasoned comparison of supplied requirements, not a score-based ranking.
legacy_comparison.novelty: Issue-level correction eligibility, revision-versus-event disambiguation, and original-study population context jointly determine whose corrected counts are being reported. Generic identity joins, source reconciliation, conflict handling and discovery dependencies already exist in the old tasks.

These are not counted as successful source checks. Available publisher content, indexed primary-source table text and supplied executed evidence support the stated findings.
